set.body:
FREEZE THE RECALL-ALIGNMENT VISUALIZATION COURT BEFORE IMPLEMENTATION. The current view module can render source-model structures, but no executable lowering consumes HsmmResult, AlignmentMatrix, or TransitionFlow. This bead defines the acceptance packet for the user-facing product target without changing the solver or claiming film support.

Exact initial path: docs/design/recall-alignment-visualization-court.md only. Read ADR 0002 D10 and the output-bundle topic summary first. Decide from source whether existing view vocabulary suffices; any new public Scala type or field needs an explicit ADR 0002 line or separate board disposition before code.

The court must specify a renderer-neutral mapping packet derived from existing accepted values, not caller labels. It must bind source identity, recall transcript identity, GraphHsmm configuration, candidate/provider/geometry identities when present, and the exact source/recall unit identifiers used by P and F. Film edition and presentation-axis identities are required once C1 exists; text fixtures must not fabricate them.

Required visible semantics: per-recall-unit posterior mass across hierarchy and fidelity mode; faithful versus each distortion facet; every external state; Unranked as aligner support failure rather than participant behaviour; Viterbi explicitly marked one summary; transition flow including backward returns, jumps, revisits, and external excursions; exact recall and source evidence; support, eligibility, missingness, imputation, and refusal; source hierarchy and time/presentation coordinates when lawful. Posterior breadth and ambiguity must remain visible rather than collapsing to a single link.

Accessibility and artifact law: the canonical target is the S4 self-contained static HTML/CSS report with inline SVG permitted, no JavaScript, no external resources, and direct filesystem opening. Every graphical fact has a textual twin; no meaning depends on colour alone; zero, missing, ineligible, imputed, suppressed, failed, and unavailable are distinguishable. Valid semantic output survives renderer failure under S3.

Executable fixture courts to name in advance: the Anna worked example; a sharp atomic anchor; scene-level gist/compression; bimodal blend; role-reversal distortion; backward transition; external association; Unranked; an omitted/missing channel; and a renderer failure with valid typed alignment output. Each court states the mutation it kills. This is an acceptance/specification slice, not authority to implement C1, acquire data, or call current posterior mass calibrated probability.
set.title: Recall alignment view: freeze the P/F uncertainty visualization court
